title.en-NZ: About you and your organisation

description.en-NZ: These questions help us understand the different parts of the industry represented in the survey. We recognise that many organisations operate across more than one activity, sector or region.

title.en-NZ: Awareness and perceived risk
Confidence and visibility

description.en-NZ: For the following questions, confidence means having enough reliable information to form a reasonable view, rather than relying only on assumptions or personal relationships.

title.en-NZ: What creates confidence?
Sharing and verifying labour information
Workforce traceability and action

description.en-NZ: Being able to establish who employed a worker, who supplied them, and where they worked is sometimes called workforce traceability.

Which regions does your organisation operate in?
Which region is the main focus of your organisation's work?
Does your organisation directly employ seasonal workers?
Approximately how many seasonal workers does your organisation employ or engage over a typical year?

description.en-NZ: Include seasonal workers employed directly by your organisation and seasonal workers supplied to your organisation by labour providers, contractors or subcontractors.
